name: Shanghai Aj Group Co.,Ltd
summary: Shanghai Aj Group Co.,Ltd, a Shanghai-based enterprise established in 1979 and previously known as Shanghai Industrial and Commercial Aiguo Construction Company, primarily delivers wealth and asset management solutions, particularly to China's financial sector. Its extensive range of services encompasses investment management, business and technical consulting, specialized technical services, property management, and general business management advisory. The company is also active in financial leasing, which involves purchasing leased properties, managing their residual value, and providing expert consultation and guarantees for leasing and rental transactions. Additionally, it engages in industrial investments, international logistics, domestic trade, real estate development and management, and the import and export of diverse commodities and technologies. Further offerings include dedicated wealth management and private equity investment services.
